cards.title: Bardiya National Park
cards.blurb: The largest untouched wilderness in the Terai, where tigers, wild elephants and rhinos roam the sal forest and grasslands.

cards.title: Karnali River
cards.blurb: Nepal's longest river spills out of the hills at Chisapani; gangetic river dolphins are sometimes seen in its waters.

cards.title: Shuklaphanta Grasslands
cards.blurb: The far-western park holds one of the largest herds of swamp deer in the world on its open phanta grasslands.

cards.title: Ghodaghodi Lake
cards.blurb: A chain of oxbow lakes in Kailali, a Ramsar wetland rich in birds, turtles and mugger crocodiles.

cards.title: Tharu Grass Basket
cards.blurb: A colourful basket woven from local grasses by Tharu women of the western plains.

cards.title: Tiger Tracking on Foot
cards.blurb: Follow a naturalist along the river beds at dawn, looking for fresh pugmarks. Roll for your sighting.

cards.title: Karnali Rafting
cards.blurb: Run the big water of the Karnali, or watch from the bank. Roll to stay in the boat.

cards.title: Maghi Dance-Off
cards.blurb: The Tharu new year festival, with dancing all night. Everyone joins — highest roll leads the ring.
